text:
```artifact
TC-001: Self-test flow sensor accuracy (positive)
Preconditions: Blower set to a certain speed, air lines open, nothing connected to the output.
Steps: Initiate self-test.
Expected: Self-test passes for flow sensor.

TC-002: Self-test flow sensor accuracy (negative: air lines closed)
Preconditions: Blower set to a certain speed, air lines closed, nothing connected to the output.
Steps: Initiate self-test.
Expected: Self-test fails for flow sensor.

TC-003: Self-test pressure sensor accuracy (positive)
Preconditions: A known pressure applied to the sensor.
Steps: Initiate self-test.
Expected: Self-test passes for pressure sensor.

TC-004: Self-test pressure sensor accuracy (negative: no pressure applied)
Preconditions: No pressure applied to the sensor.
Steps: Initiate self-test.
Expected: Self-test fails for pressure sensor.

TC-005: Controller pre-test mode support
Preconditions: Controller in normal mode.
Steps: Send command to enter pre-test mode.
Expected: Pre-test mode entered and self-test (including flow and pressure sensor checks) executed.

TC-006: GUI pre-test mode support
Preconditions: GUI running in normal mode.
Steps: Click pre-test mode button in GUI.
Expected: Pre-test mode entered and self-test (including flow and pressure sensor checks) executed.
```
